question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT league_id, home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, 
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_win
    FROM Match
    UNION ALL
    SELECT league_id, away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_win
    FROM Match
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT league_id, team_api_id, SUM(is_win) AS total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT league_id, team_api_id, total_wins,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_api_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT rt.league_id, l.name AS league_name, rt.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, CAST(rt.total_wins AS INTEGER) AS total_wins
FROM ranked_teams rt
JOIN League l ON rt.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON rt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE rt.rn = 1
ORDER BY rt.league_id
